data.title: Home contents insurer requests documents for water damage claim
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG asks for a list of damaged items with purchase receipts and photos for your water damage claim of 19 March 2026. The documents are due within 10 working days of the letter date (27 March 2026).
data.explanation: Your insurer needs more information to process your water damage claim. Send a list of the damaged items, proof of purchase (receipts) and photos of the damage. Working days (Werktage) here are Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays. The app shows the deadline. If you don't send the documents in time, the insurer will decide on the claim based on the file as it stands (nach Aktenlage), which may be worse for you. If you can't get some receipts, tell the insurer promptly.

items.title: Submit item list, receipts and photos

date.text: binnen 10 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens

items.action: Send the insurer a list of the damaged items with purchase receipts and photos of the damage.
items.consequence: The insurer will decide on the claim based on the existing file (nach Aktenlage).
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die fehlenden Unterlagen binnen 10 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens ein (Werktage sind Montag bis Samstag, ausgenommen gesetzliche Feiertage).
